---
name: Syntax or component proposal
about: Propose an AFM rule with examples, precedent, and fallback
title: ''
---

## User need

Show a real agent output that the current draft cannot express well.

## Proposed Markdown and HTML

Include a minimal example and its expected rendering. State core, optional profile, or vendor extension.

## Existing precedent

Link specifications or source implementations. Separate observed behavior from your proposal.

## Compatibility and fallback

Show what a GFM renderer and an HTML-stripping renderer produce. List conflicts and escaping rules.

## Streaming and state

Show incomplete prefixes and expected views. Explain identity, updates, user edits/expansion, interruption, and final output.

## Accessibility, security, and limits

Cover keyboard/focus, readable labels, resource loading, host actions, and bounded parsing.

## Alternatives and fixtures

Explain the trade-offs; include test cases another implementation can run. List what remains undecided.
